name: GitHub
description: Connect GitHub repository access or authenticate GitHub Copilot agents.

methods.whenToUse: Connect your GitHub account for durable MCP, shell Git, gh, and repository access.
methods.guidanceMd: Authorize Paperclip, then choose selected repositories in GitHub. You can edit repository access later from GitHub's installation settings.
methods.label: Connect GitHub
warnings: Shell Git and gh receive this identity for the run and are not constrained by per-tool Ask-first controls.

methods.whenToUse: Use the provider-hosted connection for the quickest setup.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a fine-grained token limited to the repositories agents should use.
methods.label: Personal access token (advanced)

credentialFields.label: GitHub token
credentialFields.helperMd: Repository contents, issues, pull requests and other granted toolsets; selected repos and installation/PAT permissions apply. Create a key with read and write permissions for these actions; Paperclip cannot increase an existing key’s permissions.

methods.label: GitHub Copilot personal access token
methods.whenToUse: Authenticate the GitHub Copilot agent runtime with a personal or explicitly shared account.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a personal fine-grained token with the Copilot Requests permission. Copilot authentication is separate from repository and MCP access. [GitHub authentication instructions](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-cli/set-up-copilot-cli/authenticate-copilot-cli).

credentialFields.label: Personal access token
credentialFields.helperMd: Use a personal fine-grained token with Copilot Requests permission.
